title: 真・女神転生II
sources: The harness alone, from the game's cartridge on bsnes (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. The cartridge and snaps were studied outside it
From Shin Megami Tensei (games/sfc/SFC-56A9AAB6.lua): the font's numbering (hiragana from 0x25 in the order of the fifty sounds, digits and capitals) and its rules.
Not carried: its way of reading (a list of writes to video memory, not kept here), its header, its voicing marks (here flag bits of the number), and its table; katakana stand one number earlier

Found in play: the script lies packed in the cartridge and no page stands anywhere; in snaps every frame through a page's typing, the number of the character just drawn (0x7E0504), where it was drawn (0x7E0808) and its row (0x7E0818). The script follows the typing, a character at a time
The table: the small kana and katakana's place by the font's plan; the signs and 46 kanji read in play, the number of each character drawn beside the picture of its page
Played from a new game through the wake-up talk, a day of rest and its save, and going out refused: two stretches, each replayed from a state with the script loaded
What the script said agreed with the rows read off 31 of 31 pictures, over 3 scenes (30 wholly; one lost a repeated sign, 90%). No screen without text was among them
The kanji and signs were read off the same pictures the comparison holds the script to
notes: Read by the script games/sfc/SFC-819B137D.lua: the message window's page, followed as it types, said once nothing has been added for half a second. A repeated character can still be missed now and then. Not read: menus and status boxes (drawn at other places), choices' answers, fights' messages. Kanji not met in play come out as U+FFFD.
